2026/10/7 核对本页所列官方资料。半日顺序和停留时长是编辑建议，不是实时: The listed official sources were checked on Oct 7, 2026. The order and duration are editorial suggestions, not live navigation or opening guarantees. File photos do not depict this event, today's weather or current trail conditions.
南湾 Alviso 秋日湿地：一段木栈道，一次慢观察: Alviso's autumn wetlands: a boardwalk and time to observe
免费入园，留在标示步道，不追逐粉色盐池照片: Free park entry; stay on marked paths rather than chasing pink-pond photos
从 1195 Hope Street 的 Alviso Marina 入口开始，: Start at Alviso Marina's 1195 Hope Street entrance for a short wetland visit. County picnic areas and refuge trails have different rules; specific birds and pink water are not guaranteed.
主入口、08:00 至日落、免费入园及湿地保护规则。: Main entrance, 8 AM–sunset hours, free entry and wetland protection rules.
10 月 15–18 日停车场（包括夜间）因活动布置和拆卸关闭。10 月 17: The parking lot, including overnight parking, closes October 15–18 for event setup and breakdown. The free Day on the Bay festival still welcomes visitors on October 17, 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; check official event transport details instead of planning a normal drive-and-park visit.
县公园免费入园，园区 08:00 至日落，步道日出起开放。普通宠物犬只可在县公园: Park entry is free; the park opens 8 AM–sunset and trails at sunrise. Dogs may use county-park paths and picnic areas but not refuge trails, levees or boardwalks. Walk bicycles on boardwalks, stay away from pond edges and do not fly drones.
编辑建议：给观察留一点空白: Editorial suggestion: leave room to observe
先查步道封闭信息，从已开放的短路段往返，不把绕盐池一整圈当默认路线。: Check trail closures and use a short open out-and-back section rather than assuming a complete salt-pond loop.
带望远镜或用手机远看，保持与鸟类距离；不喂食、不离开标示步道。: Observe from a distance, using binoculars if available; do not feed wildlife or leave marked paths.
把饮水、防晒和防风衣一起带上。大风或雨后路面不合适时改天，照片不保证当天颜色。: Bring water, sun protection and a wind layer. Return another day if wind or wet conditions are unsuitable; photos do not guarantee the pond's color.
选一场有官方时间的活动作为另一天的主行程。: Choose an event with confirmed times for a separate outing.
